data.name: Buccaneers and Bengals Reveal Key Injuries Ahead of Week 1 Clash
data.summary: The Bengals list defensive end Shemar Stewart as doubtful and inactive, but Ja'Marr Chase, Tee Higgins, and cornerback DJ Turner are fully cleared to play. data.name: Bengals Defense Forces Four Turnovers in 33-27 Season-Opening Win Over Buccaneers
data.summary: Cincinnati opened the 2026 season with a 33-27 victory over Tampa Bay, powered by a revamped defense that forced four turnovers, including three first-half fumbles from Baker Mayfield that led to touchdowns. Joe Burrow went 25-for-35 for 254 yards and a touchdown, while Evan McPherson nailed field goals from 55 and 58 yards. Tampa Bay fought back with a pick-six and late score from rookie linebacker Josiah Trotter, but the Bengals ran out the clock to secure their second straight Week 1 win.

data.hook: Alex Anzalone, the new captain voted in by his teammates, slipped repeatedly and missed tackles in a tough season opener. Fans didn't hold back on his rough outing.
data.name: Buccaneers Fans Slam Captain Anzalone After Loss to Bengals
data.summary: The Tampa Bay Buccaneers fell 27-33 to the Cincinnati Bengals on Sunday at Paycor Stadium, hurt by Baker Mayfield's fumbles and defensive lapses. Free agent signee Alex Anzalone faced heavy criticism for poor angles, slips, and missed tackles, with observers like Pewter Report calling him unplayable and analysts labeling him the worst on defense despite seven tackles. While some pointed to the turf or new system as factors, rookie Josiah Trotter earned praise for his pick-six debut amid the backlash against the veteran leader.

data.hook: McLane Stadium glowed yellow as Baylor fans cheered their Bears to a dominant bounce-back win, with backup QB Nate Bennett shining under the lights.
data.name: Baylor Bears Crush Prairie View A&M 44-3 in Home Opener
data.summary: After an early field goal by Prairie View A&M, Baylor surged ahead with 17 unanswered points in the first quarter and rolled to a 44-3 victory, amassing over 550 yards of offense. Nate Bennett went 23-of-35 for 301 yards, two touchdown passes including a 33-yard strike to Jayden McGowan, and a rushing score. The defense stifled the Panthers to 110 yards, while Rhett Armstrong kicked three field goals and fans in matching yellow shirts kept the energy high all night. Baylor evens its record at 1-1 ahead of Louisiana Tech next week.
